#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore the newline after the integer input
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    std::string processedLine;
    int wordsInParentheses = 0;
    size_t index = 0;

    while (index < line.length()) {
        if (line[index] == '(') {
            processedLine += '_';
            index++;
            std::string insideParentheses;
            while (index < line.length() && line[index] != ')') {
                insideParentheses += line[index];
                index++;
            }
            // Skip the closing parenthesis
            if (index < line.length() && line[index] == ')') {
                index++;
            }
            // Split insideParentheses by '_'
            std::stringstream ss(insideParentheses);
            std::string word;
            while (std::getline(ss, word, '_')) {
                if (!word.empty()) {
                    wordsInParentheses++;
                }
            }
        } else {
            processedLine += line[index];
            index++;
        }
    }

    // Split processedLine by '_'
    std::stringstream ss(processedLine);
    std::string part;
    int maxWordLength = 0;
    while (std::getline(ss, part, '_')) {
        if (!part.empty() && static_cast<int>(part.length()) > maxWordLength) {
            maxWordLength = part.length();
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxWordLength << " " << wordsInParentheses << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
